content.title: 三角色同拍｜固定阵形与同步转向
content.summary: 三个不同主体在稳定场地内同步小动作、共同转向并落在统一终姿。

quick_start.input_format: 三个可区分主体＋固定间距＋同步转向＋共同停住
quick_start.recommended_input: 橙、白、钴蓝三台半身高发条测量机器人，哑光蓝绿展示台，各自脚下有圆形标记。
required_anchors: 转向中仍保留左右关系
usage_steps: 把示例主体、场景和表层元素替换为原创概念。
让每个必需锚点和 Creative DNA 不可变条件都能在画面因果链中被看见。
选择 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 模板，只填写已声明的可替换项。
生成前检查时长、事件顺序、镜头连续性、声音和反复制约束。
applicable_scope: 三个不同主体在稳定场地内同步小动作、共同转向并落在统一终姿。
能够保留全部必需锚点的原创 4–15 秒短片。
需要可复用因果视频结构的 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 项目。
not_suitable_for: 要求复制来源人物、场景、道具、对白或镜头顺序的任务。
无法在目标时长内展示全部必需锚点的概念。
缺少紧凑因果链的长篇讲解或无关多地点叙事。

creative_dna.mechanism: A stable frontal stage and equal three-across spacing make small synchronized movement readable; coordinated orientation changes refresh the repeated dance while preserving group identity. The source has no additional proven narrative causality.

invariants.rule: Start with exactly three visibly distinct performers in a stable horizontal formation.
invariants.purpose: Supports immediate group counting and rhythm.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the row is not established the turns cannot be tracked.

invariants.rule: Coordinate small movement phrases and at least one shared direction change while retaining left-center-right spacing.
invariants.purpose: Turns repetition into a readable formation pattern.

invariants.rule: End in a shared planted pose after a final orientation change.
invariants.ablation_failure: An arbitrary cutoff leaves the phrase unresolved.

anti_copy_exclusions: No source rabbit likeness, tuxedo or red curtain setting.
No copied exact dance sequence or music claim.
No additional clones appearing or disappearing.

instantiations.concept: On a matte turquoise factory display platform, three waist-high wind-up measuring robots in orange, white and cobalt perform a calibrated demonstration. Each alternately lifts its feet three times in place over its own floor circle, turns 90 degrees together to show side profiles, returns front, lifts arms in a pulse, and finishes with all three feet planted on their respective circles.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Three color-coded measuring robots, turquoise platform, synchronized calibrated steps.

instantiations.concept: In a modern art gallery, three adult dancers in clearly different solid-color coats demonstrate a mirrored movement exercise: equal spacing, synchronized quarter-turn, two traveling steps, return front and hold a shared final line.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Three adult gallery dancers, different coats, shared turn and final line.

failure_modes.repair: Keep fixed equal spacing in frontal wide shot.
Hold visible ground contact and floor shadows.
